sections.heading: Part I — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Foundational Fluency (1–7)

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 4x + 3$ in solutions to trigonometric equations, evaluate $f(5)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 12x + 32 = 0$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 4$ and $x = 8$. Factoring $(x - 4)(x - 8) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 4$ and $x = 8$.

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 4$ in problem solving with trigonometric functions, evaluate $f(2)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 7x + 6 = 0$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 1$ and $x = 6$. Factoring $(x - 1)(x - 6) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 1$ and $x = 6$.

questions.q: A data set recorded for problem solving with trigonometric functions consists of the four values $\{17, 21, 25, 31\}$. What is the arithmetic mean? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $23.5$. The sum is $17 + 21 + 25 + 31 = 94$, and dividing by $4$ gives $23.5$.
questions.explanation: The sum is $17 + 21 + 25 + 31 = 94$, and dividing by $4$ gives $23.5$.

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 4$ in problem solving with trigonometric functions, evaluate $f(3)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 9x + 14 = 0$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 2$ and $x = 7$. Factoring $(x - 2)(x - 7) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 2$ and $x = 7$.

sections.heading: Part II — Free-Response Questions (FRQs): Intermediate Multi-Step Application (8–14)

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 4$ in problem solving with trigonometric functions, evaluate $f(4)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 11x + 24 = 0$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 3$ and $x = 8$. Factoring $(x - 3)(x - 8) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 3$ and $x = 8$.

questions.q: For the model $f(x) = 5x + 4$ in problem solving with trigonometric functions, evaluate $f(5)$.
Find the positive solutions to the quadratic equation $x^2 - 13x + 36 = 0$.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $x = 4$ and $x = 9$. Factoring $(x - 4)(x - 9) = 0$ yields the roots $x = 4$ and $x = 9$.

questions.q: In $\Delta  ABC$ studying double angle identities, $m\angle A = 49^\circ$ and $m\angle B = 45^\circ$. What is $m\angle C$? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $86^\circ$. Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (49^\circ + 45^\circ) = 86^\circ$.
questions.explanation: Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (49^\circ + 45^\circ) = 86^\circ$.

questions.q: A geometric figure scaled by factor $k = 2$ has an original side length of $8\mathrm{\ cm}$. What is the corresponding image length? Show your complete algebraic work.
questions.answer: Final Answer: $16\mathrm{\ cm}$. Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $8 \times 2 = 16\mathrm{\ cm}$.
questions.explanation: Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $8 \times 2 = 16\mathrm{\ cm}$.

questions.q: On the coordinate plane, a line with slope $m = 2$ passes through $(0, 5)$. What is its $y$-coordinate when $x = 1$? Show your complete algebraic work.
